messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Kannada, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------| | **Tant'** | Intensifier of *amara* | Use Kannada intensifier **ಅಷ್ಟು** before the adjective *ಕಹಿ* (bitter) → **ಅಷ್ಟು ಕಹಿ**; **[Back‑translation: so bitter]** | | **è** | Copular verb linking subject to predicate | Render with present copula **ಇದೆ** (is) after the subject (implicit “it”) → **ಇದೆ**; **[Back‑translation: is]** | | **amara** | Predicate adjective “bitter” | Translate as **ಕಹಿ** (bitter), agreeing in gender/number with the implicit neuter subject; **[Back‑translation: bitter]** | | **che** | Comparative subordinator “that” | Use comparative particle **ಗಿಂತ** (than) to introduce the comparison; **[Back‑translation: than]** | | **poco** | Degree adverb “little, slightly” | Translate as **ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ** (slightly) modifying the comparative adjective; **[Back‑translation: slightly]** | | **è** | Copular verb in comparative clause | Render with present copula **ಇದೆ** after the comparative subject; **[Back‑translation: is]** | | **più** | Comparative adverb “more” | Use comparative adjective **ಹೆಚ್ಚು** (more) following **ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ**; **[Back‑translation: more]** | | **morte** | Noun “death” (comparative “more” element) | Translate as **ಮರಣ** (death) in nominative; combine with **ಗಿಂತ** and **ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚು** to form **ಮರಣವು ಕಹಿಗಿಂತ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚು**; **[Back‑translation: death is slightly more]** | | **ma** | Coordinating conjunction “but” | Render as **ಆದರೆ** (but); **[Back‑translation: but]** | | **per** | Preposition marking purpose | Use purpose marker **ಗಾಗಿ** after infinitive; **[Back‑translation: for]** | | **trattar** | Infinitive “to treat/discuss” | Translate as infinitive **ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲು** (to discuss); attach purpose marker **ಗಾಗಿ** → **ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲುಗಾಗಿ**; **[Back‑translation: to discuss]** | | **del** | Prepositional article “of the” | Render as **ದ** (genitive case) attached to noun **ಭಲ** (good) → **ಭಲದ**; **[Back‑translation: of the]** | | **ben** | Noun “good” (object of discussion) | Translate as **ಭಲ** (good) in genitive after **ದ**; **[Back‑translation: good]** | | **ch'** | Relative pronoun “that” | Use relative particle **ಅದು** (that) introducing relative clause; **[Back‑translation: that]** | | **i'** | Pronoun “I” | Render as **ನಾನು** (I) in nominative; **[Back‑translation: I]** | | **vi** | Locative adverb “there” | Translate as **ಅಲ್ಲಿ** (there); **[Back‑translation: there]** | | **trovai** | Past tense “found” | Use past tense verb **ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದೆ** (found) with first‑person singular; **[Back‑translation: I found]** | | **dirò** | Future tense “I will tell” | Use future tense verb **ಹೇಳುವೆ** (will tell) first‑person singular; **[Back‑translation: I will tell]** | | **de** | Prepositional article “of the” | Render as **ನಿಂದ** (from) or **ಬಗ್ಗೆ** (about) depending on context; here **ಬಗ್ಗೆ** (about) attached to noun phrase; **[Back‑translation: about]** | | **l'altre** | Determiner “the other” | Translate as **ಇತರ** (other) with definite article **ಆ** → **ಆ ಇತರ**; **[Back‑translation: the other]** | | **cose** | Noun “things” (object of “dirò”) | Translate as **ವಸ್ತುಗಳು** (things) in accusative; **[Back‑translation: things]** | | **ch'** | Relative pronoun “that” | Use **ಅದು** (that) to introduce relative clause; **[Back‑translation: that]** | | **i'** | Pronoun “I” | Render as **ನಾನು** (I); **[Back‑translation: I]** | | **v'** | Locative adverb “there” | Translate as **ಅಲ್ಲಿ** (there); **[Back‑translation: there]** | | **ho** | Auxiliary “have” for perfect | Use auxiliary **ಇದೆ** (have) in present perfect construction; **[Back‑translation: have]** | | **scorte** | Past participle “seen” | Translate as past participle **ಕಂಡ** (seen) agreeing with object; combine with auxiliary → **ಕಂಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ** (have seen); **[Back‑translation: have seen]** |

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Output: bullet list only; one line per source line. Format: - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Rules: each phrase is directly placeable (no glue-only fragments) and covers the line’s main predicate + required linkage. Hook: satisfy Step 2 requirements for that line (incl. back-translation checks). Comparatives: preserve ordering (A>B ⇔ B<A is OK) and degree; at least one phrase must make both recoverable. No punctuation inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 7: ಅದು ಕಹಿ ಆಗಿದೆ ಮರಣವು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚು / ಮರಣವು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಹಿಗಿಂತ / ಕಹಿ ಆಗಿರುವುದು ಮರಣವು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚು - Line 8: ಆದರೆ ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಉತ್ತಮವನ್ನು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲು / ಆದರೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಉತ್ತಮವನ್ನು ನಾನು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲು / ಆದರೆ ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತಮವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲು - Line 9: ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಇತರ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳುವೆ / ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಇತರ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಹೇಳುವೆ / ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಇತರ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಳುವೆ

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Task: Assemble Step3 phrases into Kannada lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 phrases as contiguous substrings; reorder within line as needed. Allowed edits: insert only function-words/morphology for grammatical joining; no new content words. Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary Step3 phrase: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte;
**Line Inventory:** - ಮರಣವು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಹಿಗಿಂತ
**Assembly Notes:** - Inserted copular verb **ಇದೆ** after the phrase to complete the clause.
**Target Text:** ಮರಣವು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಹಿಗಿಂತ ಇದೆ;
**Source Line:** 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai,
**Line Inventory:** - ಆದರೆ ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಉತ್ತಮವನ್ನು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲು
**Assembly Notes:** - Inserted purpose marker **ಗಾಗಿ** after the infinitive phrase.
**Target Text:** ಆದರೆ ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಉತ್ತಮವನ್ನು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲುಗಾಗಿ,
**Source Line:** 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte.
**Line Inventory:** - ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಇತರ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳುವೆ
**Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; phrase already satisfies the required structure.
**Target Text:** ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಇತರ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳುವೆ.

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step4 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line #**: 7 **Target Text**: ಮರಣವು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಹಿಗಿಂತ ಇದೆ; **Back-Translation**: Death is slightly more than bitter. **Reference Translation**: So bitter is it that death is little more. **Checks**: End Punct OK, Coverage OK, Meaning Drift OK, Comparative Orientation OK, Hallucination OK **Corrected Target Text**:
- **Line #**: 8 **Target Text**: ಆದರೆ ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಉತ್ತಮವನ್ನು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲುಗಾಗಿ, **Back-Translation**: But for discussing the good that I found there, **Reference Translation**: But in order to treat of the good that there I found, **Checks**: End Punct OK, Coverage OK, Meaning Drift OK, Comparative Orientation N/A, Hallucination OK **Corrected Target Text**:
- **Line #**: 9 **Target Text**: ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಇತರ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳುವೆ. **Back-Translation**: I will tell about the other things that I saw there. **Reference Translation**: I will tell of the other things that I have seen there. **Checks**: End Punct OK, Coverage OK, Meaning Drift OK, Comparative Orientation N/A, Hallucination OK **Corrected Target Text**:
```kannada ಮರಣವು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಹಿಗಿಂತ ಇದೆ; ಆದರೆ ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಉತ್ತಮವನ್ನು ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲುಗಾಗಿ, ನಾನು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಇತರ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳುವೆ. ```
